title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, bump actions and deps, split lint/test/release for hygiene
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: our CI workflows have grown organically and are increasingly slow and flaky. This PR consolidates shared workflow logic, splits responsibilities (lint/test/release) for clearer ownership and caching characteristics, and updates key GitHub Actions and build deps to reduce maintenance burden and improve cache hit rates. Changes are primarily workflow YAMLs and a small set of housekeeping updates to package.json devDependencies used by CI. Checklist: - [x] Extract common workflow/steps into .github/workflows/workflow-templates (composite actions) - [x] Split lint/test/release into dedicated workflows with tailored caches and matrix sizing - [x] Bump actions/setup-node v3 -> v4 and actions/cache upgrade for improved cache pruning - [x] Upgrade node versions used in CI matrix to node 20 where safe, keep node 18 legacy jobs for pinned repos - [x] Fix flaky test by increasing jest timeout and stabilizing DB teardown in perf-canary integration tests - [x] Add long-running job guard and stale-run cleanup for release automation - [x] Update contributor docs section for running checks locally This description includes links and references inline: Linear ENG-17234 covers the workflow split proposal and ENG-18001 is the follow-up for actions upgrades.
commits: c1a4f3b: extract: add composite workflow templates for node matrix and checkout-cache
9b2d7e1: feat(ci): split lint/test/release workflows + tailored caching
4e8b21d: fix(tests): increase jest timeout for perf-canary integration to reduce flakes
e2a5f00: docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md with new workflow instructions
d3b1f9c: chore: pin node 18 job for legacy releases
review_comments: Diego Morales: Overall looks good. Can we avoid running full matrix for lint? Suggest running lint only on node 20 and ubuntu-latest to speed things up.
Maya Thompson: Good point — updated lint.yml to run a smaller matrix (node 20 / ubuntu) and added explicit comment explaining rationale.
Samantha Li: I saw a transient CI failure on initial run (cache miss + npm ci timeout). Can we make cache key fallback more permissive?
Maya Thompson: Adjusted cache key to include OS and node major version; added fallback to restore-keys for partial hits. Re-ran CI and observed improved cache hits.
Rajiv Gupta: Release job still runs on every push for redwood-helm-charts subdir. Please gate release workflow to only run on changes to helm charts or tag events.

Maya Thompson: Added path filter for redwood-helm-charts release workflow and a manual_dispatch input for ad-hoc runs. Also added a protection to avoid double releases when both main and release branches push.
Samantha Li: Approve after CI green.
Diego Morales: Approved. Minor note: add a short blurb in the release notes about caching improvements for infra teams.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows and upgraded GitHub Actions (setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4). Split lint/test/release into dedicated workflows for improved caching and reduced runtime. Minor test stability fixes applied. No user-facing behavior changes.
notes: Follow-up tasks: monitor cache hit rate (ENG-18001), roll out node20-only runners for internal repos (ENG-18290). Kept node18 legacy job for repositories that require it; we should remove node18 jobs after 2026-06.
